name: Action
description: The primary action a creature takes on its turn. The slot you spend to do something significant — Attack, Dash, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or to take a Magic action (Cast a Spell), Influence (2024), Study (2024), or Utilize an object.

name: Bonus Action
description: A faster supplementary slot granted by specific class features, spells, or feats — only one per turn. You can't take a Bonus Action unless something specifically grants you one.

name: Reaction
description: An instant response triggered by a specific event — Opportunity Attack, the Shield spell, the Cutting Words feature. You get one per round and recover it at the start of your turn.

name: Free Object Interaction
description: Interact with one nearby object as part of your turn at no slot cost — drawing a weapon, opening a door, picking up a dropped item. Sometimes called a Free Action. A second interaction in the same turn requires the Utilize action.
